values.note: 2027 on the booking site: 20/30-amp sites $34 weeknights, $37 Saturday; 50-amp sites $39 / $42 (probed 2027-05-20, 07-13 and Sat 07-17). 2026: $32 (20/30-amp) and $37 (50-amp) in the DNR rates table and on the booking site for 2026-10-27. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

values.note: 130 sites on two loops (the booking site's 130 include a host site). Allowed trailer/RV length: 'over 50 ft' at six sites (4, 6, 13, 51, 52, 66), 40-50 ft at 34 more, 25-35 ft at most others; nine are tent-only. Site 13 is the pull-through. The DNR says the sites are generally not flat.

note: Modern campground of Proud Lake Recreation Area, two loops at 2537 Glengary Rd (Commerce Twp) set on Proud Lake: some sites have lake views, others sit against the woods. Buoyed swim area in the campground; the park's stretch of the Huron River is a Type I trout stream. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: 130 sites, 50-amp (confirmed), no sewer, showers, dump (confirmed), vault toilets (new), reservable on MiDNRReservations / 800-447-2757, reservation season Apr 15 - Oct 31 (new). Changed max_rig_ft 45 -> 50 (six sites allow 'over 50 ft'), pull_through false -> true (DNR tag 'Pull-through sites available'; site 13), fees 32/37 (2026) -> 34/42 (2027 booking site: 20/30-amp $34 weeknight to 50-amp $42 Saturday). Pin is on the modern campground (OSM 'Modern Campground' ~90 m); the park's other camping is group-use (Red Oaks, Pines) plus cabins and a lodge, with equestrian trails but no horse campground. Phone matches. Note cleaned ('back-in' contradicted; field restatements dropped).
